name: dataset-desk v0.1.2
body: report --count-tokens runs the gate's 64-token test with the cached SigLIP2 tokenizer, offline. Before it, the command line never passed a token counter, so a record that passed every other test stayed unchecked.
Error code DEP_TOKENIZER_MISSING (exit 1) when --count-tokens can't find the tokenizer.
report no longer stops when --out and the project are on different Windows drives: links fall back to file:// URIs where a relative path can't cross drives.
The tokenizer load no longer logs the bos/eos config warning, like the model load in 0.1.1.
152 offline tests; line coverage 96%, CI floor 90.

name: dataset-desk v0.1.1
body: Model loads pass dtype instead of the deprecated torch_dtype (SigLIP2, and EmbeddingGemma 2's model_kwargs).
SigLIP2 loads no longer log transformers' bos/eos token-id warning. Its published config sets those ids outside the text vocabulary, and the desk never uses them. Errors still show.
The models extra now needs transformers>=4.56 (the first with dtype) and sentence-transformers>=5.
145 offline tests; line coverage 96%, CI floor 90.

name: dataset-desk v0.1.0

Backends: EmbeddingGemma 2 (eg2), SigLIP2 so400m (siglip2), and none, the torch-free lite tier.

A 30-number look channel (palette, tone, native-resolution texture), and outliers ranked by content and by look.

name: interlock v0.1.0 (prototype)
body: Prototype. interlock is a local AI device router for one rig. It suggests a model, an engine and a device for each job (embed, rerank, NLI, verify, generate) from measured receipts, and it never serves traffic. Every…
or uv tool install mcptoolshop-interlock. Python 3.12 only. The command and the import are interlock.

interlock route answers from a routing table of committed receipts. It ranks by the worst repeat, not the median, and refuses, naming the experiment behind the gap, when no measured row meets the constraints.
interlock check validates every receipt and the routing table. It refuses home paths, hosts, URLs and token-shaped values.

The measurement harness: device guards for the 5090, NPU and iGPU, a watcher that writes the receipt before stopping on a compile timeout, RAM or a stop file, and the E3–E5 experiments behind the table.
